name: cognee
description: Cognee is an open-source AI memory platform that transforms raw text, files, and URLs into a persistent knowledge graph.

name: persistent knowledge graph
description: persistent knowledge graph is the store that Cognee produces and that agents can query.

name: litellm
description: litellm is a dependency of Cognee used for LLM routing.

name: llm routing
description: LLM routing is the functionality for which Cognee depends on litellm.

name: ladybug
description: Ladybug is a lightweight, in-process graph store that Cognee uses as its default graph backend and that is designed for local development.

name: local development
description: local development is the environment for which Ladybug is designed.

name: alice
description: Alice is a person who works at Anthropic, lives in San Francisco, and contributes to the Cognee project.

name: anthropic
description: Anthropic is the organization where Alice works.

name: san francisco
description: San Francisco is the city where Alice lives.

name: remember
description: remember is the Cognee verb that ingests data and runs the extract-cognify-load pipeline.

name: extract-cognify-load pipeline
description: extract-cognify-load pipeline is the pipeline run by remember that chunks input, extracts entities and relationships with an LLM, embeds chunks, and stores results in a graph database and a vector store.

name: chunking
description: chunking is the pipeline step that splits input into chunks.

name: original chunks
description: original chunks are the chunked inputs that ground recall answers to prevent invention by the language model.

name: entity and relationship extraction
description: entity and relationship extraction is the pipeline step that uses an LLM to extract entities and relationships from chunks.

name: llm
description: LLM is the language model used to extract entities and relationships in the pipeline.

name: embedding
description: embedding is the pipeline step that embeds chunks into vectors.

name: graph database
description: graph database is where the pipeline stores extracted structured data.

name: vector store
description: vector store is where the pipeline stores embeddings of chunks.

name: recall
description: recall is the Cognee verb that queries the graph by combining a vector similarity step with graph traversal so answers stay grounded in original chunks.

name: vector similarity
description: vector similarity is the recall step that helps find relevant chunks.

name: graph traversal
description: graph traversal is the recall step that traverses the knowledge graph during queries.

name: forget
description: forget is the Cognee verb that evicts data from the graph.

name: raw text
description: raw text is one input type that Cognee transforms into a persistent knowledge graph.

name: files
description: files are input types that Cognee transforms into a persistent knowledge graph.

name: urls
description: URLs are input types that Cognee transforms into a persistent knowledge graph.
